_comment: Platform card (step 092): environment contract + machine facts shared by ALL models. Extracted from tools/serve_gsq_prod029_n2.cmd and the step-085 boot readings so launchers stop hand-copying them per model. Every value carries source: platform = this card's own fact, measured = read off a boot, human-copied = debt awaiting derivation.

env._note: source=platform (model-independent, 交接文档 §2 contract); vcvars64 must be called before launch; LIB prepends CUDA lib\x64

kv_pool_speed_switch.fact: auto-sized pool walks into the residency cliff on this card under graphs+DFlash2; a hand-pinned --kv-cache-memory-bytes is the speed lever (step 090: auto 1.72 GiB -> 4.83/5.49 tok/s vs pinned 0.745 GiB -> 79.9-86.6)

graph_capture_reservation_gib.source: measured (step 090 s1; VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS=0 skips it at own risk)

pin_env._note: GSQ production carries these; Orca arms ran with shim but doors OFF (step 091 diff). Un-proven as the 090 slow-mode cause - pending the 092 single-variable experiment

exl3_empty_shared_flag.name: ORCA_EXL3_ALLOW_EMPTY_SHARED
exl3_empty_shared_flag.needed_when: EXL3 checkpoint x speculative family (MTP/EAGLE/DFlash2 draft shares embed/lm_head after load)

probes.anchor: tools/anchor_longctx.py (8k anchor, production-watchdog compatible, --model for non-GSQ)
